dialogues.speaker: Banka
dialogues.text: Yeah, you're right. It's his life, after all, so should it be his decision.

dialogues.speaker: Banka
dialogues.text: There's plenty of time, so there's no need for us to rush.

dialogues.speaker: Banka
dialogues.text: Look, here's something he brought back recently. Most of these flowers grow in high places. He would never have been able to pick them before — that would have been unthinkable.
